reason: A DSH media plugin that presents searchable YouTube Shorts and Bilibili vertical videos in a switchable carousel with continuous playback and floating or edge-panel controls.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 中以浮窗或贴边竖栏浏览和播放可搜索的 YouTube Shorts 与哔哩哔哩竖屏视频。
summaries.en: Browse and play searchable YouTube Shorts and Bilibili vertical videos in DSH through a floating or edge-panel player.

capabilities: Fetches anonymous public search data from YouTube and Bilibili
Embeds YouTube playback and streams Bilibili video through a host proxy
Provides a draggable, resizable, minimizable floating or edge-panel interface
Stores keyword and playback preferences in localStorage
Uses keyboard, mouse-wheel, and button controls for media navigation
